description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_db2' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' to provide database schema manipulation methods specifically for IBM DB2 within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for type conversion, altering columns, dropping columns, and changing table schemas.

classes.name: ADODB2_db2
classes.description: A class for handling DB2 database schema operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts meta type codes to actual DB2 data types, supporting custom meta types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column definitions, including default values, nullability, and identity.

methods.name: alterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter columns in a DB2 table.

methods.name: dropColumnSql
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a column from a DB2 table.

methods.name: changeTableSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to modify table schema, including altering existing columns or creating new tables.
